abstractEnglish: We prove the abelian Zilber–Pink conjecture over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$. Every irreducible subvariety of an abelian variety has only finitely many maximal atypical subvarieties, where atypicality is measured inside its smallest containing torsion coset.
